displayAddress: Adelphi Court, Manor Road, Bournemouth, Dorset, BH1
description:
Avenue Estates are delighted to present this TWO DOUBLE BEDROOM second floor apartment situated in a PRESTIGIOUS BLOCK within WALKING DISTANCE OF BOURNEMOUTH BEACH. This impressive apartment boasts ALLOCATED PARKING, an EN-SUITE SHOWER ROOM, and is offered with NO FORWARD CHAIN.

Accommodation is spacious, well proportioned and bright throughout and comprises a large inviting entrance hall with multiple fitted storage cupboards, a modern fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, a family bathroom, a primary bedroom with fitted wardrobe space and an en-suite shower room, a further double bedroom also benefitting from fitted wardrobe space, and an impressive central living room with double doors looking out over the Juliet balcony. 

Adelphi Court boasts evident curb appeal with a well maintained frontage and block paved parking area of which the apartment benefits from an allocated space. The block offers a lift to all floors which can be accessed via the well maintained lobby with an impressive vaulted ceiling and seating area.

Leasehold with approximately 103 years remaining
Service Charge of £1,943 per annum
Ground Rent of £125 per annum
